case_aliases: Opaque zero-padded ordinals; no original mapping or target hashes exported

GN_metrics.harness_final_EM: Selected native last guess exact match
GN_metrics.actor_final_EM: Explicit final actor answer; PCoT random fallback and ToT early selection stay null
GN_metrics.hit_at_any: At least one selected/logged guess matches

null_semantics: Unavailable/undefined; never false/zero. Failed GN row metrics are null.

bootstrap.seed: 26102653+contrast_index; same seed across metrics within contrast
bootstrap.order: Sorted zero-padded aliases preserve original lexicographic ID order
bootstrap.interpretation: Posthoc descriptive complete-pair percentile intervals; no multiplicity adjustment or success threshold

SP_metrics: Character overlap F1 primary; word overlap F1 diagnostic; not semantic accuracy
usage_verification: Whole-run usage is copied from the bound private audit; this numeric verifier does not replay raw token accounting
verification_limit: Checks arithmetic and published file hashes; does not independently prove private scoring or actual model execution
